title: Wow!
body: This is an app is incredible! The features are truly amazing and so user friendly. I highly recommend it to anyone looking to become more productive and defeat procrastination. Thank you Amazing Marvin!
author: 147two3nine

title: More features
body: It’s a great app, use it all the time to organise. ( since that’s what it’s meant for ) just can’t wait for it to be updated and to make more use of the screen and for it to become better accessible to features such as choosing a date.
author: tahlia0456

title: A fairly basic companion to great web app
body: The ‘Amazing Marvin’ web app is fabulous for those who like a lot of control over productivity workflows etc - and getting better all the time. This mobile app has just enough for me to get by when I’m not on a computer. I really look forward to continuing improvements!
author: Lkjhg74

title: Doesn't sync
body: It's not sync'ing with the webapp, is this still in beta?
